text.en: Final blows with this weapon collapse victims into Void Transmutation spheres.

Intrinsically deals 40% more PvE damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.

Kills with this weapon's beam turn the target into a Transmutation Sphere.

Transmutation Spheres are considered a generic 'Void Weapon'. They benefit from Empowering and Void-Verb Buffs, but are unaffected by nor trigger Ability, Trace Rifle, or Weapon Surge effects.
